meta.name: glycoengineering
meta.description: Analyze and engineer protein glycosylation. Scan sequences for N-glycosylation sequons (N-X-S/T), predict O-glycosylation hotspots, and access curated glycoengineering tools (NetOGlyc, GlycoShield, GlycoWorkbench). For glycoprotein engineering, therapeutic antibody optimization, and vaccine design.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析蛋白质糖基化位点,辅助抗体与疫苗设计
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在做治疗性抗体或疫苗的糖基化设计。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze protein glycosylation sites to support antibody and vaccine design.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you engineer glycosylation for therapeutic antibodies or vaccines.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能扫描蛋白质序列，找出 N-糖基化位点（N-X-S/T，X≠P）。它也能预测 O-糖基化热点、给出消除或添加糖基化位点的序列修改建议，并引导使用相关外部工具。
howto.when: 当用户要求分析或改造蛋白质糖基化时触发，比如提供序列查找糖基化位点、询问抗体或疫苗的糖基化设计。

say.text: 帮我扫描这段蛋白序列的N-糖基化位点
say.note: 返回位点位置、序列和上下文

say.text: 把这条序列第120位的天冬酰胺(N)突变成谷氨酰胺(Q)
预测这段序列的O-糖基化热点
say.note: 输出Ser/Thr富集区域的热点位置

howto.what_en: Scans protein sequences for N-glycosylation sequons (N-X-S/T, X≠P), predicts O-glycosylation hotspots from Ser/Thr density, and suggests mutations to add/remove sites. Points to external tools like NetOGlyc, GlycoShield, GlycoWorkbench.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to analyze or engineer protein glycosylation, e.g., provides a sequence for glycosylation site scanning, or asks about antibody/vaccine glycan design.

say_en.text: Scan this sequence for N-glycosylation sites.
Mutate position 120 Asn to Gln to remove a glycosite.
Predict O-glycosylation hotspots in this sequence.
